# Kanerika

> > Kanerika is a global consulting firm specializing in AI, analytics, automation, and cloud modernization solutions for enterprises.

Kanerika provides end-to-end consulting and development services across generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, RPA, data governance, analytics, and cloud migration. The firm is known for its proprietary migration accelerator platform (FLIP) and custom AI agents, helping enterprises modernize legacy systems and implement advanced data and AI solutions.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI
- Agentic AI
- Machine Learning
- Robotics Process Automation (RPA)
- Data Analytics
- Data Governance
- Data Integration
- Microsoft Fabric
- Power BI
- Azure Cloud
- Data Migration
- Legacy Modernization
- FLIP Migration Accelerator
- Business Intelligence
- Cloud Strategy

## AI & Intelligent Automation Services

- [Generative AI Development Services for Your Business](https://kanerika.com/services/generative-ai): Generative AI services including LLM and RAG implementation for enterprises.
- [Advance Agentic AI Consulting Services & Solutions](https://kanerika.com/services/agentic-ai): Agentic AI consulting with DokGPT, Karl, Alan, Susan for enterprise automation.
- [Expert AI & ML Consulting & Development Services](https://kanerika.com/services/ai-ml): AI and ML consulting with NLP, demand forecasting, and optimization solutions.
- [Next-Gen Robotics Process Automation (RPA) Solutions | Kanerika](https://kanerika.com/services/rpa): RPA solutions using Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere for workflows.

## Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

- [Expert Data Analytics Consulting & Solutions | Kanerika](https://kanerika.com/services/data-analytics): Data analytics using Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Power BI.
- [Advance Data Integration Solutions & Services | Kanerika](https://kanerika.com/services/data-integration): Data integration services with Fabric, Databricks, Informatica platforms.
- [Professional Data Governance Consulting Solutions](https://kanerika.com/services/data-governance): Data governance with KANGovern, KANGuard, KANComply for compliance.

## Platform & Legacy System Migration

- [Advance Data Migration Consulting Services & Solution](https://kanerika.com/services/migration): Data migration consulting for BI platform and ETL modernization services.
- [Expert Tableau to Power BI Migration Services](https://kanerika.com/services/migration/tableau-to-power-bi): Tableau to Power BI migration with DAX conversion and dashboard rebuild.
- [Expert Cognos to Power BI Migration Services](https://kanerika.com/services/migration/cognos-to-power-bi): Cognos to Power BI migration using FLIP migration accelerator tool.
- [Professional SSRS to Power BI Migration Services](https://kanerika.com/services/migration/ssrs-to-power-bi): SSRS to Power BI migration with expert planning and secure data handling.
- [Crystal Reports to Power BI Migration Services](https://kanerika.com/services/migration/crystal-reports-to-power-bi): Crystal Reports to Power BI migration with full report rebuilding support.

## ETL & Data Platform Migration

- [Expert Informatica to Databricks Migration Services](https://kanerika.com/services/migration/informatica-to-databricks): Informatica to Databricks ETL migration using FLIP platform automation.
- [Expert Informatica to Microsoft Fabric Migration Services](https://kanerika.com/services/migration/informatica-to-microsoft-fabric): Informatica to Microsoft Fabric migration with FLIP accelerator platform.
- [Expert Informatica to Alteryx Migration Services](https://kanerika.com/services/migration/informatica-to-alteryx): Informatica to Alteryx migration using FLIP Migration Accelerator platform.
- [Expert Informatica to Talend Migration Services](https://kanerika.com/services/migration/informatica-to-talend): Informatica to Talend migration services with FLIP migration accelerator.
- [SQL Services to Microsoft Fabric Migration Services](https://kanerika.com/services/migration/sql-services-to-microsoft-fabric): SQL Server SSIS/SSAS to Microsoft Fabric migration with minimal downtime.
- [Professional Azure to Fabric Migration Services](https://kanerika.com/services/migration/azure-to-fabric): Azure Data Factory and Synapse to Microsoft Fabric migration services.
